overloadMerges.note: The two doc syntax lines differ only in whether the leading '*' is passed (selecting whether object is a name-string vs. a Variable/Field reference); collapsed into one overload with an optional literal-symbol discriminator.

params.name: asObjectName
params.description: If specified, object is an object name (string); if omitted, object is a variable or a field.

params.name: object
params.description: Object name (if * is specified) or Variable or field (if * is omitted)

params.name: foregroundColor
params.description: RGB color value for foreground (CSS name, "#rrggbb"/"rgb(r,g,b)" string, 4-byte 0x00rrggbb integer, or 4D system color constant); pass "" to leave it unchanged

params.name: backgroundColor
params.description: RGB color value for background (same formats as foregroundColor, plus "transparent"); pass "" to leave it unchanged

params.name: altBackgrndColor
params.description: RGB color value for the alternating (even-row) background, list boxes/list box columns only; pass "" to leave unchanged

params.name: borderColor
params.description: Border RGB color in CSS text or integer format; pass "" to leave unchanged. Introduced in 21 R5.

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Sets, for the current process, foreground, background and optionally alternating-background and border colors of the designated object(s).

constraints: Pass "" in any of foregroundColor, backgroundColor, altBackgrndColor or borderColor to leave that color unchanged.
borderColor requires a form object that supports borderColor and a plain or dotted border (except for custom-styled buttons); it is unavailable in binary databases.
"transparent" can only be used for backgroundColor and altBackgrndColor.

altBackgrndColor only takes effect when object designates a list box or a list box column; when it is used, backgroundColor then applies only to odd-numbered rows and altBackgrndColor to even-numbered rows.
If object designates a whole list box, alternating colors apply to the entire list box; if it designates a single column, only that column uses the given colors.
